book.name: MATYU
book.title: MATYU Temani Kaiéle MATYU-ni Turum Bukele

content: 4:1-11 Kurumanga Nuim Seten-ni Yesos Kundi Turum Temanele
Yesos ⸤no liirim kene Pulu Yili-nga Minéle yu-kene omba molupa kene,⸥ Minéle yu-ni ‘⸤Kurumanga nuim⸥ depollale-ni yu kundi tupili.’ nimba Yesos kolea-wakana memba purum.
Akuna Yesos kaliimbu te kóru tale mele langi naa nuli we molupa pirim kene yu engle-ni kolupa mulurum.
Kanu-kene kundi tuli ⸤kuru Seten⸥ omba kene yundu nimba mele: “Nu Pulu Yili-nga Málale lem ku-mulú ima ‘Pllawa kaluli au talupili.’ ni.” nirim.
Akiliinga-pe yu-ni pundu topa kene nimba mele: “Pulu Yili-nga bukele-ni nimba mele:
nimba molemú.” nirim.
Kanu-kene depollale-ni Yesos liipa kolea-auli Jerusallem, akilindu ‘kolea-auli kake tili’ niliele, akuna memba pupa, Pulu Yili popu toku kaluring lku-temboll imuna memba, aima ola pupa monjupa kene,
yundu nimba mele: “Nu Pulu Yili-nga Málale lem nu tepa liimba akiliinga pu-nikunu mania pui.” ⸤nirim.⸥ “Pulu Yili-nga bukele-ni nimba mele:

content.text: Enini nu ‘Ku te-ni kepe naa tupili.’ niku
nu eninga kima-ni oku kanglku liingí.’ Konana 91:11-12

content: nimba molemú kanili. Aku-sipa nirimeliinga piliiku kene aku-sikunu ti.” nirim.
Yesos-ni yundu nimba mele: “Pulu Yili-nga yambumandu ung te wasie nimba molemúko. Akili i-sipa mele:

content.text: niku eni yu manda leku naa teai.’ Ung-Manima 6:16

content: nimba molemúko kanili.” nirim.
Alsupa depollale-ni yu liipa ma-pangí te aima ola-kilia lirimna memba ola pupa monjupa kene, yu ma-koleama pali kene koleamanga méle kaíma wasie liipa ora sipa kene
yundu nimba mele: “Nu nanga kumbi-kerina koporungu languku mania molkunu na popu tokunu nanga bili paka tunjúnu lem nu ma-koleana méle lelemú kanokunu ima pali nu simbu.” nirim.
Kanu-kene Yesos-ni yundu nimba mele: “Seten, nu anju pa! Pulu Yili-nga bukele-ni nimba mele:

content.text: ‘Pulu Yili eninga Auliele mindi niku popu toku
yunga kongunuma mindi tenjiku molai.’ Ung-Manima 6:13

content: nimba molemú kanili.” nirim.
Kanu-kene depollale-ni Yesos yu mundupa kelepa yu purum. Purum kene ⸤mulú-koleana⸥ angkellama-ni oku Yesos nukuring.
4:12-17 Yesos-ni Kolea Gallalli Distrik Pulu Monjupa Yambuma Ung Nimba Sirim Temanele
Kanu-kene ⸤No-Liinjili⸥ Jon ka siku ka-lkuna panjiringele piliipa kene Yesos kelepa kolea Gallalli distrik-ndu yandu omba

Nasaret taon-na omba kene, penga taon akili mundupa kelepa Kapeniam taon, numú-Gallalli kéluna lirim, akuna pupa ‘Ekupu kolea ili nanga kamu molumbu koleale lipili.’ nimba akuna mulurum. Kapeniam yi Sepullan kene Naptallai-seleni kalku liiringli yambuma ui muluring koleana lirim.

⸤Kapeniam taon-na pupa mulurumeliinga⸥ kórunga-ui Pulu Yili-ni “Ninjui!” nimba ung nimba sirimuma piliipa yambuma nimba sirim yi Asaya-ni ulu te penga wendu ombá ui nirim mele kamu wendu urum. Asaya-ni nimba mele:

content.text: Yambu aima sumbulú túlina molemele kanuma
talang tondulu aima auli te kanuring.
Kululi ulu-pulele-ni panda topa sumbulú tuli koleana
pelemelé yambumanga koleana talang pukum.” Asaya 9:1-2

content: nirim.

⸤Kapeniam omba mulurum⸥ ena kaniliinga Yesos-ni yambuma pulu monjupa ungma nimba sipa kene nimba mele: “Pulu Yili yi nuim kingele molupa nokumba enale nondupa wendu ombá tekemaliinga ⸤‘Pulu Yili yu-ni nokumba yambumanga talapena sukundu molamili.’ niku⸥ ulu-pulu-kis telemelema munduku kelku numanu topele tai.” nirim.
4:18-22 Yesos-ni Yi Angerendu “Na Lumbili Wai.” Nirim Temanele

Yesos Numú-Gallalli kéluna andupa kene anginingli tale kanurum, akusele Saimon kene angin Endru-sele oma liili wale te no-numúna toku suku munduku muluringli kanurum. Penga Saimon-nga bi te Pita niringko. Oma liiringli akili elsengla ku-moni kongunale tiringli.

⸤Aku-siku teku muluringli kanupa kene⸥ nimba mele: “Na lumbili wangli. Oma liinglíndu oma liili wale te liiku nona suku mundulimbili kene omama walena omba pelemú mele, penga ‘nanga kongunale tinglíndu nanga ungele piliikulu niku silsiliiku andunglí kene yambuma nanga talapena sukundu oku molangi.’ nimbu ‘Else na lumbili wale.’ niker.” nirim.
⸤Aku nirim mele piliikululiinga⸥ lkisikulu elsengla oma liili walema munduku kelkulu kene Yesos lumbili puringli.

Kanu-kene yu laye-kolte anju pupa kene anginingli tale lupa kanurum, akusele Seperi málu Jemis kene Jemis angin Jon-sele, lapa Seperi kene eninga nona anduli sipna sukundu oma liili walema toku tambulku muluring kanupa kene elsele walsipa kene “Na lumbili wale.” nirim.
Aku nirim mele piliikulu kene elsengla lapa Seperi kene nona anduli sipele kene lkisikulu munduku kelkulu kene Yesos yu lumbili puringli.
4:23-25 Yesos-ni Kolea Gallalli Distrik Ungele Nimba Silsiliipa Andupa Yambu Kuru Turum Pulele Tepa Kaí Tirim Temanele

Kanu-kene Yesos kolea Gallalli distrik sukundu koleamanga pali andupa, Juda-yambuma máku toku Pulu Yili-nga ungele piliiring lkumanga lkundu pupa yambuma ung-bo tonjupa, Pulu Yili nondupa yi nuim kingele molupa nokumba mele temani kaiéle topa sipa, yambu kuru lupa-lupa turum-ma kene kangina ulu pulele tirim-ma kene tepa kaí tirim.

Yu-ni tirim mele temanele kolea Siria propinj koleamanga pali anju-anju purum piliiku kene eninga yambu kuru lupa-lupa turum yambuma kene, mindili lupa-lupa noku muluring yambuma kene, yambumanga numanuna kuru molku ambuluring yambuma kene, kuru-kopari turum yambuma kene, kimbu-ki kukurum yambuma kene, yu mulurumna meku uring kene yu-ni yambu kanuma tepa kaí tirim.

Yambu aima pulele yu lumbili puring. Kolea Gallalli distrik yambuma kene, ‘Kolea-Auli Rurepunga Tale’ niring kolea yambuma kene, kolea Judia distrik lirim kolea-auli Jerusallem yambuma kene, kolea Judia sukundu lirim we-koleamanga muluring yambuma kene, no Jodan nekendu koleamanga yambuma kene, aima pulele yu lumbili puring.
